var el=$('invList');if(!el)return;el.innerHTML='';
ensureSheet();var s=state.sheet;
if(s.inventory.length===0){el.innerHTML='<p class="help">Inventário
vazio.</p>';return;}
for(var i=0;i<s.inventory.length;i++){
var it=s.inventory[i];var
div=document.createElement('div');div.className='inv-item'+(it.equipped?'
eq':'');
var w=(parseFloat(it.weight)||0);var
total=(w*(parseInt(it.qty,10)||1)).toFixed(1);
div.innerHTML='<div class="inv-top"><input type="checkbox" class="chk"
'+(it.equipped?'checked':'')+' data-eq="'+it.id+'"><span
class="nm">'+esc(it.name)+'</span><button type="button" class="rm" data-
rm="'+it.id+'">×</button></div>'+
'<div class="meta">Peso: '+total+' kg</div>'+
'<div class="qty-ctl"><span class="lbl-qt">Qtd</span><button type="button"
data-minus="'+it.id+'">−</button><span class="qv">'+(it.qty||1)+'</span><button
type="button" data-plus="'+it.id+'">+</button></div>';
el.appendChild(div);
}
var cbs=el.querySelectorAll('[data-eq]');
for(var
j=0;j<cbs.length;j++){(function(cb){cb.addEventListener('change',function(){var
it=findItem(cb.getAttribute('data-
eq'));if(it){it.equipped=cb.checked;state.sheet.ready=false;pushSheet();updateS
heetStatusUI();}});})(cbs[j]);}
var rms=el.querySelectorAll('[data-rm]');
for(var
k=0;k<rms.length;k++){(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){var
id=b.getAttribute('data-rm');for(var
x=0;x<state.sheet.inventory.length;x++){if(state.sheet.inventory[x].id===id){state
.sheet.inventory.splice(x,1);break;}}state.sheet.ready=false;renderInventory();re
nderSheet();pushSheet();updateSheetStatusUI();});})(rms[k]);}
var plus=el.querySelectorAll('[data-plus]');
for(var
p=0;p<plus.length;p++){(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){var
it=findItem(b.getAttribute('data-
plus'));if(it){it.qty=(parseInt(it.qty,10)||1)+1;state.sheet.ready=false;renderInvento
ry();renderSheet();pushSheet();updateSheetStatusUI();}});})(plus[p]);}
var minus=el.querySelectorAll('[data-minus]');
for(var
m=0;m<minus.length;m++){(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){var
it=findItem(b.getAttribute('data-minus'));if(it){it.qty=(parseInt(it.qty,10)||1)-
1;if(it.qty<=0){for(var
x=0;x<state.sheet.inventory.length;x++){if(state.sheet.inventory[x].id===it.id){sta
te.sheet.inventory.splice(x,1);break;}}}state.sheet.ready=false;renderInventory();
renderSheet();pushSheet();updateSheetStatusUI();}});})(minus[m]);}
}

function openAttackModal(targetId){
var target=findCombatant(targetId);
if(!target){toast('Alvo não encontrado');return;}
ensureSheet();var s=state.sheet;
var mySpells=(s.spells||[]).slice();
var html='<h2>󱟋 Atacar '+esc(target.name)+'</h2>';
html+='<p class="help">Alvo: PV '+target.pv+'/'+target.pvMax+' · CA
'+target.ca+' · RM '+target.rm+'</p>';

html+='<div class="attack-option" data-attack="atkc"><span class="ao-
name">Ataque Corporal</span><span class="ao-meta">Corpo a corpo ·
FOR</span><span class="ao-formula">d20 + '+s.attrs.for+' vs CA
'+target.ca+'</span></div>';
html+='<div class="attack-option" data-attack="atkl"><span class="ao-
name">Ataque de Precisão</span><span class="ao-meta">À distância ·
DES</span><span class="ao-formula">d20 + '+s.attrs.des+' vs CA
'+target.ca+'</span></div>';
html+='<div class="attack-option" data-attack="atkm"><span class="ao-
name">Ataque Mágico</span><span class="ao-meta">Magias direcionadas ·
INT</span><span class="ao-formula">d20 + '+s.attrs.int+' vs RM
'+target.rm+'</span></div>';
if(mySpells.length>0){
html+='<div class="section-lbl">Magias</div>';
for(var i=0;i<mySpells.length;i++){
var spName=mySpells[i];var sp=null;
for(var
j=0;j<SPELLS.length;j++)if(SPELLS[j].n===spName){sp=SPELLS[j];break;}
if(!sp)continue;
var cd=10+s.attrs.int+(sp.ci-1);
var formula='';
if(sp.t==='I')formula='d20 + '+s.attrs.int+' vs RM '+target.rm;
else if(sp.t==='II')formula='Alvo rola d20+atrib vs CD '+cd;
else formula='Efeito direto';
html+='<div class="attack-option" data-spell="'+esc(sp.n)+'"><span
class="ao-name">✨ '+esc(sp.n)+'</span><span class="ao-meta">Círculo
'+sp.ci+' · Tipo '+sp.t+'</span><span class="ao-
formula">'+formula+'</span></div>';
}
}
html+='<div id="attackResultArea"></div>';
html+='<div style="text-align:right;margin-top:14px;"><button type="button"
class="btn ghost" id="closeAttack">Fechar</button></div>';
$('modalContent').innerHTML=html;$('modalBack').className='modal-back
show';
$('closeAttack').addEventListener('click',function(){$('modalBack').className='
modal-back';});
var ab=document.querySelectorAll('#modalContent [data-attack]');
for(var
k=0;k<ab.length;k++){(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){resolveAt
tack(b.getAttribute('data-attack'),target);});})(ab[k]);}
var sb=document.querySelectorAll('#modalContent [data-spell]');
for(var
m=0;m<sb.length;m++){(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){var
n=b.getAttribute('data-spell');var sp=null;for(var
x=0;x<SPELLS.length;x++)if(SPELLS[x].n===n){sp=SPELLS[x];break;}if(sp)res
olveSpell(sp,target);});})(sb[m]);}

function resolveAttack(kind,target){
ensureSheet();var s=state.sheet;var modifier=0,label='';
if(kind==='atkc'){modifier=s.attrs.for;label='Ataque Corporal (d20+FOR)';}
else if(kind==='atkl'){modifier=s.attrs.des;label='Ataque de Precisão
(d20+DES)';}
else if(kind==='atkm'){modifier=s.attrs.int;label='Ataque Mágico (d20+INT)';}
var defense=(kind==='atkm')?target.rm:target.ca;
var d20=rollOne(20);var total=d20+modifier;
var critical=(d20===20);var fumble=(d20===1);
var hit=critical||(!fumble&&total>=defense);
var weaponDamage='1d6';
for(var i=0;i<s.inventory.length;i++){
if(s.inventory[i].equipped){
var nm=s.inventory[i].name.toLowerCase();
for(var j=0;j<EQUIPMENT.length;j++){
if(EQUIPMENT[j].n.toLowerCase()===nm&&EQUIPMENT[j].dmg&&EQUIPMEN
T[j].dmg!=='—'){weaponDamage=EQUIPMENT[j].dmg;break;}
}
break;
}
}
state.pendingAttack={attackerName:state.user.name,targetId:target.id,targetNa
me:target.name,
hit:hit,critical:critical,fumble:fumble,d20:d20,total:total,defense:defense,
defenseType:(kind==='atkm'?'RM':'CA'),weaponDamage:weaponDamage,label:l
abel};
var html='<div class="attack-result">';
html+='<div class="hit '+(hit?'yes':'no')+'">'+(critical?'⭐
CRÍTICO!':(fumble?'💀 FALHA!':(hit?'✓ ACERTO':'✗ ERRO')))+'</div>';
html+='<div class="detail">'+label+'</div>';
html+='<div class="detail">d20 ('+d20+') + '+modifier+' =
<strong>'+total+'</strong> vs '+(kind==='atkm'?'RM':'CA')+' '+defense+'</div>';
if(hit){
html+='<div class="detail" style="color:#4a6a3a;font-weight:600;">Próximo
passo: rolar o dano ('+weaponDamage+')</div>';
html+='<button type="button" class="btn full green" id="rollDamageBtn"
style="margin-top:10px;">🎲 Rolar Dano</button>';
}else html+='<div class="detail">Nenhum dano aplicado.</div>';
html+='</div>';
$('attackResultArea').innerHTML=html;
var opts=document.querySelectorAll('#modalContent .attack-option');
for(var k=0;k<opts.length;k++)opts[k].style.pointerEvents='none';
addLog({type:'dice',who:state.user.name,time:now(),
roll:{rolls:[d20],kept:[d20],modifier:modifier,total:total,sides:20,count:1,mode:'nor
mal',critical:critical,fumble:fumble,label:'Ataque vs '+target.name}});
addLog({type:'system',text:label+' →
'+(critical?'CRÍTICO':(fumble?'FALHA':(hit?'ACERTO':'ERRO')))+' ('+total+' vs
'+state.pendingAttack.defenseType+' '+defense+')',time:now()});
if(hit){var
db=$('rollDamageBtn');if(db)db.addEventListener('click',rollDamageAndApply);}
else pushCombat();
}
function rollDamageAndApply(){
if(!state.pendingAttack)return;
var pa=state.pendingAttack;
var target=findCombatant(pa.targetId);
if(!target){toast('Alvo não encontrado');return;}
var dr=rollDiceExpr(pa.weaponDamage);
var detail=dr.detail;var total=dr.total;
if(pa.critical){var
extra=rollDiceExpr(pa.weaponDamage);total+=extra.total;detail+=' +
'+extra.detail+' (CRÍTICO)';}
target.pv=Math.max(0,target.pv-total);
var html='<div class="attack-result" style="margin-top:10px;">';
html+='<div class="hit yes">󰢊 '+total+' DE DANO</div>';
html+='<div class="detail">'+detail+'</div>';
html+='<div class="detail">'+esc(target.name)+': PV '+target.pv+' /
'+target.pvMax+'</div>';
html+='<button type="button" class="btn full ghost" id="closeAfterDamage"
style="margin-top:10px;">Fechar</button></div>';
$('attackResultArea').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',html);
var db=$('rollDamageBtn');if(db)db.disabled=true;
var
cb=$('closeAfterDamage');if(cb)cb.addEventListener('click',function(){$('modalB
ack').className='modal-back';});
addLog({type:'dice',who:state.user.name,time:now(),
roll:{rolls:dr.rolls,kept:dr.rolls,modifier:0,total:total,sides:0,count:1,mode:'normal',
critical:false,fumble:false,label:'Dano em '+target.name}});
addLog({type:'system',text:state.user.name+' causou '+total+' de dano em
'+target.name+' (PV '+target.pv+'/'+target.pvMax+')',time:now()});
pushCombat();state.pendingAttack=null;
}
function resolveSpell(sp,target){
ensureSheet();var s=state.sheet;
var cd=10+s.attrs.int+(sp.ci-1);
var html='';
if(sp.t==='I'){
var d20=rollOne(20);var total=d20+s.attrs.int;
var critical=(d20===20);var fumble=(d20===1);
var hit=critical||(!fumble&&total>=target.rm);
html='<div class="attack-result"><div class="hit
'+(hit?'yes':'no')+'">'+(critical?'⭐ CRÍTICO!':(fumble?'💀 FALHA!':(hit?'✓
ACERTO':'✗ ERRO')))+'</div>';
html+='<div class="detail">'+esc(sp.n)+' (Tipo I)</div><div class="detail">d20
('+d20+') + '+s.attrs.int+' = '+total+' vs RM '+target.rm+'</div>';
if(hit){
html+='<div class="detail" style="color:#4a6a3a;font-weight:600;">Próximo
passo: rolar dano ('+sp.ci+'d8)</div>';
html+='<button type="button" class="btn full green" id="rollSpellDmgBtn"
style="margin-top:10px;">🎲 Rolar Dano</button>';
state.pendingSpell={sp:sp,target:target,critical:critical};
}else html+='<div class="detail">Nenhum dano.</div>';
html+='</div>';$('attackResultArea').innerHTML=html;
addLog({type:'dice',who:state.user.name,time:now(),
roll:{rolls:[d20],kept:[d20],modifier:s.attrs.int,total:total,sides:20,count:1,mode:'no
rmal',critical:critical,fumble:fumble,label:'Magia '+sp.n+' vs '+target.name}});
var opts=document.querySelectorAll('#modalContent .attack-option');
for(var k=0;k<opts.length;k++)opts[k].style.pointerEvents='none';
if(hit){var
db=$('rollSpellDmgBtn');if(db)db.addEventListener('click',rollSpellDamage);}
}else if(sp.t==='II'){
var resistAttr=(sp.rs||'DES').toLowerCase();
var targetPlayer=null;
for(var
i=0;i<state.players.length;i++)if(state.players[i].name===target.name||(state.play
ers[i].sheet&&state.players[i].sheet.name===target.name))targetPlayer=state.pl
ayers[i];
var toId=null;var toName=target.name;
if(targetPlayer)toId=targetPlayer.id;
else{toId=state.room.data.gm;toName=state.room.data.gmName||'Mestre';}
var reason=(targetPlayer?'Você é o alvo.':'Rolar em nome de
'+target.name+'.');
var sendRequest=function(attrVal){
var reqId=uid()+uid();
var
data={id:reqId,fromId:state.user.id,fromName:state.user.name,toId:toId,toName:
toName,kind:'resist',
label:sp.n,attr:resistAttr,attrValue:attrVal,cd:cd,reason:reason,
targetCombatantId:target.id,targetName:target.name,spell:sp.n,status:'pending',
createdAt:Date.now()};
fbPut('rooms/'+state.room.code+'/rollRequests/'+reqId,data,function(e){
if(e){toast('Erro: '+e.message);return;}
html='<div class="attack-result"><div class="hit">📨 Convite
enviado</div>';
html+='<div class="detail">'+esc(sp.n)+' (Tipo II · Resistência
'+sp.rs+')</div>';
html+='<div class="detail">Alvo: <strong>'+esc(toName)+'</strong> deve
rolar d20 + '+resistAttr.toUpperCase()+' ('+attrVal+') contra CD '+cd+'</div>';
html+='<div class="detail" style="font-style:italic;">Aguarde o resultado no
log.</div></div>';
$('attackResultArea').innerHTML=html;
addLog({type:'system',text:'📨 '+state.user.name+' lançou '+sp.n+' em
'+target.name+' — aguardando resistência (CD '+cd+')',time:now()});
});
};
if(targetPlayer){fbGet('users/'+targetPlayer.id+'/sheet',function(err,sh){var
av=1;if(!err&&sh&&sh.attrs&&sh.attrs[resistAttr])av=sh.attrs[resistAttr];sendReq
uest(av);});}
else sendRequest(1);
var opts2=document.querySelectorAll('#modalContent .attack-option');
for(var k2=0;k2<opts2.length;k2++)opts2[k2].style.pointerEvents='none';
}else{
html='<div class="attack-result"><div class="hit yes">✨ EFEITO
DIRETO</div>';
html+='<div class="detail">'+esc(sp.n)+' (Tipo III)</div><div
class="detail">'+esc(sp.de)+'</div></div>';
$('attackResultArea').innerHTML=html;
addLog({type:'system',text:state.user.name+' usou '+sp.n+' (efeito
direto)',time:now()});
var opts3=document.querySelectorAll('#modalContent .attack-option');
for(var k3=0;k3<opts3.length;k3++)opts3[k3].style.pointerEvents='none';
}
}
function rollSpellDamage(){
if(!state.pendingSpell)return;
var ps=state.pendingSpell;var sp=ps.sp;var target=ps.target;
var dr=rollDiceExpr(sp.ci+'d8');
var detail=dr.detail;var total=dr.total;
if(ps.critical){var extra=rollDiceExpr(sp.ci+'d8');total+=extra.total;detail+=' +
'+extra.detail+' (CRÍTICO)';}
target.pv=Math.max(0,target.pv-total);
var html='<div class="attack-result" style="margin-top:10px;">';
html+='<div class="hit yes">✨ '+total+' DE DANO</div>';
html+='<div class="detail">'+detail+'</div>';
html+='<div class="detail">'+esc(target.name)+': PV '+target.pv+' /
'+target.pvMax+'</div>';

function init(){
try{
setupAuth();setupLobby();setupGame();
var sess=loadSession();
if(sess&&sess.userId){
fbGet('users/'+sess.userId,function(err,u){
if(!err&&u){state.user={id:sess.userId,name:u.name,slug:u.slug};enterLobby();}
else{clearSession();$('authScreen').style.display='flex';}
});
}else $('authScreen').style.display='flex';
}catch(e){showError('init: '+(e.message||e));}
}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentL
oaded',init);else init();
})();
</script>
